name: Portugal
first_steps: Resolve the historical freguesia and municipality for the event.
Use Digitarq and official archive directories to identify the actual custodian and series.
Use IRN/conservatória routes for civil certificates when appropriate; confirm transfers rather than applying a universal date cut-off.
Use CRAV for services offered by the identified participating archive.
jurisdiction_questions: Is this the mainland, Madeira or the Azores? Identify the relevant regional custody route.
Did the record remain at the conservatória or transfer to an archive?
Does the creator belong to a parish, court, notary, institution or overseas administration?

limits: This is an original starter profile, not a complete country guide or a list of confirmed holdings for any person.
Identify the event locality, period and record creator; verify survival, transfers, indexing and image access with the custodian.
Expand beyond these seeds through regional, municipal, religious, institutional and private finding aids. Do not infer birthplace, religion or ancestry from a name.
